# LLMS.txt — PAWLO™ Developer & Agent Context
> Machine-readable context guide for LLMs, Autonomous Coding Agents, and Copilots.

## Project Overview
- **Name**: PAWLO™ (The Urban Pet Operating System)
- **Primary Domain**: Urban Pet Care, Geospatial Real-Time Radar, Direct-to-Care Conversational Commerce.
- **Tech Stack**:
  - **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons, Leaflet / React-Leaflet.
  - **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+, PostGIS EPSG:4326), Deno / TypeScript Edge Functions.
  - **AI / LLM Integration**: DeepSeek-V3 & DeepSeek-R1 (Flash / Reasoner) with strict deterministic Pharmacological Firewall.
  - **CRM & Messaging**: GoHighLevel REST API v2 + WhatsApp Universal Links (E.164).
  - **Design System**: PAWLO Stitch Neo-Glass 2026 (Dark & Light modes with dynamic root classes).

## Architectural Guidelines for LLMs

### 1. Medical & Pharmacological Safety Shield
- Under no circumstances should an LLM formulate, dosage, or recommend pharmaceutical drugs (e.g., paracetamol, ibuprofen, ivermectin, meloxicam, tramadol) for pets.
- When evaluating user symptoms, enforce the 3-tier triage system:
  - `RED`: Immediate physical emergency (0h). Direct referral to 24/7 emergency clinics.
  - `YELLOW`: Urgent within 12h. Hydration advice only, physical exam required.
  - `GREEN`: Ethology, routine wellness, environmental enrichment.

### 2. Multi-City Node Model
- Do NOT hardcode cities. Use the `CityNode` interface:
  ```typescript
  interface CityNode {
    id: string;          // e.g. 'cue', 'uio', 'bog', 'lim'
    name: string;        // 'Cuenca', 'Quito', etc.
    country: string;
    center: [number, number]; // [lat, lng] WGS84
    status: 'active' | 'beta' | 'coming_soon';
    currency: string;    // 'USD', 'COP', 'PEN'
    paymentRail: string; // 'Deuna & Pichincha', 'Yape', 'Nequi'
  }
  ```

### 3. Spatial Queries with PostGIS
- Queries rely on `ST_DWithin` over indexed `geography(Point, 4326)` columns.
- SLA requirement: `< 10ms` execution time achieved via GiST R-Tree indexing.

### 4. Direct Commerce & Resilient Outbox
- All service booking flows generate a WhatsApp URL (`https://wa.me/`) with international format E.164.
- In backend Edge Functions, always wrap third-party CRM calls (GoHighLevel) in try/catch blocks with local fallback references (`PWL-[CITY]-[HASH]`) to prevent user blocking during external outages.

### 5. WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) & Agentic Commerce
- **Standard**: Follows Chrome Modern Web Guidance for declarative forms and imperative tools.
- **Declarative Form Attributes**: Forms must provide `toolname`, `tooldescription`, and `toolautosubmit="true"`.
- **Imperative Registration**: `document.modelContext.registerTool()` with `AbortController` signal and `readOnlyHint` attributes.
- **Global Fallback**: `window.pawloWebMCP` and `window.pawloAgentTools`.
- **Zero API Cost Edge Engine**: Clinical triage & dietary formulas run in-browser (`offlineTriage.ts`) backed by `IndexedDB` (`indexedDbStorage.ts`), reducing server and DeepSeek API costs by 90%+.

## File Map
- `src/App.tsx`: Main modular application shell with tab switcher, city switcher, and dual theme.
- `src/services/webmcp.ts`: WebMCP agent manager registering 8 production tools for agentic commerce and triage.
- `src/services/offlineTriage.ts`: Edge triage & regulatory pharmacological firewall.
- `src/services/indexedDbStorage.ts`: IndexedDB persistence and API savings telemetry.
- `src/components/AgenticWebMCPConsole.tsx`: Interactive WebMCP & Agentic Commerce developer test runner.
- `src/components/PetStoreMarketplace.tsx`: Agentic e-commerce with declarative search and checkout forms.
- `src/components/MyPetsVault.tsx`: Clinical records, vaccines, photos, and biometric data.
- `src/components/PawloLogo.tsx`: Biometric paw icon + animated status node + responsive wordmark.
- `src/index.css`: Design system CSS variables for Dark and Light modes.
- `docs/WEBMCP_AGENTIC_COMMERCE.md`: Full architectural specification for WebMCP and Agentic Commerce.
- `supabase/functions/pet-assistant/`: DeepSeek router with deterministic pharma regex blocking.
- `tests/run_validation_suite.py`: Synthetic test suite for safety shields and spatial benchmarks.
